compass.description: Your general task hub. Describe the outcome and I will route it to the right specialist.

1.description: Break down goals, steps, timing, and deliverables
1.followUpPrompt: Review the goal breakdown above for missing dependencies, then make the next action specific with an owner, start time, and definition of done.
1.materialHint: Goal, deadline, current progress, and constraints (optional)
1.output: Goal breakdown, milestones, priorities, and next actions
1.prompt: Break down [goal] into executable steps with milestones, priorities, deadlines, and the next action.
1.title: Goal breakdown

2.description: Schedule stages, timing, owners, and checkpoints
2.followUpPrompt: Review the execution plan above and add the critical path, resource conflicts, risk triggers, and acceptance criteria for each checkpoint.
2.materialHint: Goal, deadline, available resources, participants, and constraints (optional)
2.output: Phased execution plan with timeline, owners, checkpoints, and risk responses
2.prompt: Create an execution plan for [goal] with phased tasks, timing, owners, checkpoints, risks, and adjustment conditions.
2.title: Execution plan

3.description: Weigh cost, risk, and expected results
3.followUpPrompt: Extend the comparison above with weighted criteria and sensitivity analysis, and explain which changes would justify choosing the other option.
3.materialHint: Options, budget, time constraints, and decision criteria (optional)
3.output: Option comparison, trade-offs, fit conditions, and an evidence-based recommendation
3.prompt: Compare [option A] and [option B] by cost, outcome, risk, and fit, then make a clear recommendation.
3.title: Compare options

4.description: Combine goals, context, evidence, risks, and recommendations
4.followUpPrompt: Refine the analysis above by separating facts, assumptions, and open questions, then rank the recommendations by impact and urgency.
4.materialHint: Question, background, objective, data, and constraints (optional)
4.output: Current-state assessment, evidence, key factors, risks, opportunities, and actions
4.prompt: Analyze [question] comprehensively. Confirm the goal and context, then assess evidence, key factors, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
4.title: Comprehensive analysis

content.description: Plan topics and turn ideas into publishable writing and social content.

1.description: Define audience, angle, and a content series
1.followUpPrompt: Select the three strongest ideas from the topic plan above and add title directions, an outline, material needs, and a recommended publishing order for each.
1.materialHint: Theme, platform, audience, account positioning, and reference content (optional)
1.output: Grouped topic ideas with angles and reasons to prioritize them
1.prompt: Plan topics about [subject]. Confirm the platform, audience, and goal, then give me 10 specific ideas with reasons.
1.title: Topic planning

2.description: Write a complete, editable long-form piece
2.followUpPrompt: Edit the long-form draft above for factual support and logical gaps, then improve the title, opening, transitions, and closing call to action.
2.materialHint: Theme, audience, platform, tone, length, and factual material (optional)
2.output: Long-form draft with a title, opening, section structure, and closing action
2.prompt: Write a long-form [platform] piece about [subject]. Confirm audience, tone, and length, then deliver a title, opening, structured body, and closing action.
2.title: Long-form writing

3.description: Design the hook, spoken lines, visuals, and pace
3.followUpPrompt: Turn the short-video script above into a second-by-second plan covering spoken lines, visuals, captions, transitions, and required materials.
3.materialHint: Topic, platform, audience, video length, product information, and references (optional)
3.output: Short-video script with a hook, spoken lines, visual cues, pacing, and call to action
3.prompt: Write a [platform and duration] short-video script about [topic], including the hook, spoken lines, visual cues, pacing, and call to action.
3.title: Short-video script

4.description: Preserve meaning while refining structure, voice, and expression
4.followUpPrompt: Compare the polished copy above with the original, explain the key changes, then provide one more concise version and one more engaging version.
4.materialHint: Original copy, platform, audience, target tone, and facts to preserve (optional)
4.output: Polished copy that preserves meaning, with change notes and title options
4.prompt: Improve and polish the copy I provide while preserving its facts and intent. Refine the title, opening, structure, voice, and pace.
4.title: Rewrite and polish

ecommerce.description: Solve product, store, and conversion problems with practical operating materials.

1.description: Write headlines, benefits, scenarios, and conversion copy
1.followUpPrompt: Review the product copy above, separate verifiable facts from marketing language, and optimize the opening section, benefit section, and call to action.
1.materialHint: Product details, audience, specifications, proven benefits, and supporting evidence (optional)
1.output: Product headline, layered benefits, use cases, proof points, and call to action
1.prompt: Write product copy for [product]. Confirm the audience, price range, and proven benefits, then provide a headline, layered benefits, use cases, proof points, and call to action.
1.title: Product copy

2.description: Plan objectives, cadence, channels, and execution
2.followUpPrompt: Turn the campaign plan above into an execution schedule with daily milestones, owners, budget allocation, inventory alerts, and review metrics.
2.materialHint: Campaign objective, products, budget, period, channels, inventory, and historical data (optional)
2.output: Campaign theme, audience, timeline, channel actions, budget, and review metrics
2.prompt: Create a campaign plan for [product or store], covering the objective, audience, cadence, channel actions, budget, inventory risks, and review metrics.
2.title: Campaign plan

3.description: Compare positioning, price, content, and customer feedback
3.followUpPrompt: Extend the competitor analysis above with evidence sources and differentiation priorities, then propose three small experiments that can be tested immediately.
3.materialHint: Your product, competitor materials, prices, page content, and customer reviews (optional)
3.output: Competitor report covering positioning, price, claims, page content, and review differences
3.prompt: Analyze [competitor] across positioning, price, claims, page content, and reviews, then identify differentiation opportunities.
3.title: Competitor analysis

4.description: Analyze reviews and prepare customer-service responses
4.followUpPrompt: Turn the review analysis above into an action list, then refine the responses and escalation rules for presales, objections, shipping, and after-sales.
4.materialHint: Product or store details, customer reviews, FAQs, shipping, and after-sales policies (optional)
4.output: Review themes, improvement actions, and customer-service scripts for presales and support
4.prompt: Analyze customer reviews for [product or store], identify recurring issues and improvements, then create customer-service responses for presales, objections, shipping, and after-sales.
4.title: Reviews and customer service

family.description: Plan home, family, and parenting tasks with clear, practical steps.

1.description: Plan routes, timing, cost, and alternatives
1.followUpPrompt: Expand the travel plan above into a daily itinerary with transport connections, booking deadlines, cost ranges, child or older-traveler needs, and weather alternatives.
1.materialHint: Destination, family members, dates, budget, travel preferences, and constraints (optional)
1.output: Travel route, schedule, costs, bookings, and alternative plans
1.prompt: Create a travel plan for a family trip to [destination]. Confirm travelers, dates, and budget, then provide routes, timing, costs, bookings, and alternatives.
1.title: Travel plan

2.description: Organize items, owners, timing, and completion status
2.followUpPrompt: Review the family checklist above, merge duplicates, and add an owner, deadline, prerequisite, and final pre-departure check where relevant.
2.materialHint: Household task, family members, deadline, available items, and special needs (optional)
2.output: Family checklist grouped by category with owners, timing, and completion checks
2.prompt: Turn [household task] into a family checklist grouped by category, with items or tasks, owners, timing, and completion checks.
2.title: Family checklist

3.description: Compare price, quality, risks, and use cases
3.followUpPrompt: Re-rank the purchase options above by budget, essential needs, and risk, then list the specifications and support terms that must be verified before buying.
3.materialHint: Candidate products, budget, use needs, specifications, reviews, and warranty terms (optional)
3.output: Purchase comparison with key trade-offs, risks, and a recommendation
3.prompt: Compare the purchase options [product A] and [product B] by price, quality, features, reviews, support, and fit, then recommend one.
3.title: Purchase comparison

4.followUpPrompt: Check the schedule above for conflicts and add buffer time, family assignments, reminder points, and alternatives for last-minute changes.
4.materialHint: Family members, fixed events, available times, priorities, and preferences (optional)
4.output: Schedule by date and person, with conflicts, buffer time, and reminders
4.prompt: Turn [household task] into a schedule plan with timing, owner assignments, required items, and reminders.
4.title: Schedule plan

office.description: Turn documents, spreadsheets, meetings, and source material into polished deliverables.

1.description: Build a formal document from source material
1.followUpPrompt: Edit the document draft above for structure, facts, terminology, and tone, list the information that still needs my confirmation, and then provide a revised version.
1.materialHint: Source material, document type, audience, purpose, length, and format (optional)
1.output: Clear document structure, working draft, and open questions
1.prompt: Turn my source material into a [document type]. Confirm the audience and purpose, then produce a clear structure and draft.
1.title: Document writing

2.description: Clean, analyze, and summarize business data
2.followUpPrompt: Validate the spreadsheet analysis above, explain metric definitions, anomaly handling, and conclusion limits, then recommend the most useful charts.
2.materialHint: Spreadsheet, field definitions, business questions, date range, and metric rules (optional)
2.output: Cleaning notes, key metrics, anomalies, findings, and chart suggestions
2.prompt: Process the spreadsheet I provide. Explain what can be read, then clean it, analyze key metrics, and summarize findings.
2.title: Spreadsheet analysis

3.followUpPrompt: Review the meeting minutes above, separate decisions, action items, and open questions, and add an owner, deadline, and dependency for each item.
3.materialHint: Transcript, notes, attendee list, and meeting agenda (optional)
3.output: Decisions, action items, owners, deadlines, and unresolved questions
3.prompt: Turn these meeting notes into minutes with decisions, action items, owners, deadlines, and open questions.
3.title: Meeting minutes

4.description: Develop an outline, key points, and slide flow
4.followUpPrompt: Expand the presentation outline above into a slide-by-slide script with each slide’s main conclusion, evidence needs, speaking time, and visual treatment.
4.materialHint: Presentation topic, audience, duration, available data, and brand template (optional)
4.output: Slide-by-slide purpose, key points, evidence needs, and visual direction
4.prompt: Create a presentation outline for [topic]. Confirm the audience, goal, and duration, then give slide-by-slide points and data needs.
4.title: Presentation outline

research.description: Organize evidence, compare viewpoints, and build learning plans while making uncertainty visible.

1.description: Organize sources, themes, evidence, and open questions
1.followUpPrompt: Refine the source organization above by removing duplicates, marking corroborating or conflicting evidence, and producing a prioritized verification list.
1.materialHint: Files or links, organization goal, research scope, and source standards (optional)
1.output: Source catalog with thematic summaries, evidence references, reliability notes, and open questions
1.prompt: Organize the [source material] I provide by theme, source, key finding, evidence, and reliability, then list open questions.
1.title: Source organization

2.followUpPrompt: Review the viewpoint comparison above for evidence strength and limits of applicability, and explain what new evidence would change the current judgment.
2.materialHint: Question, main viewpoints, available sources, and decision criteria (optional)
2.output: Evidence matrix, agreements, disagreements, conditions, and a balanced judgment
2.prompt: Compare different viewpoints on [question], including evidence, disagreements, applicable conditions, and a balanced conclusion.
2.title: Viewpoint comparison

3.followUpPrompt: Turn the learning plan above into a detailed first week with daily tasks, exercises, success checks, and an adjustment plan if progress falls behind.
3.materialHint: Learning goal, current level, available time, deadline, and existing resources (optional)
3.output: Learning stages, weekly tasks, materials, practice, and checkpoints
3.prompt: Create a learning plan for [topic] based on my current level, available time, and goal, with stages, resources, and exercises.
3.title: Learning plan

4.description: Develop a complete report with question, method, findings, and conclusion
4.followUpPrompt: Edit the research report above by separating conclusions, evidence, and inference, strengthening the limitations section, and prioritizing what still needs verification.
4.materialHint: Research question, sources, analysis scope, audience, and format requirements (optional)
4.output: Research background, method, evidence, findings, limitations, conclusion, and recommendations
4.prompt: Write a research report about [research question], covering background, method, sources, findings, limitations, conclusions, and recommendations.
4.title: Research report

video.description: Create scripts, shot plans, and editing directions that can move straight into production.

1.description: Plan spoken lines, visuals, and pace
1.followUpPrompt: Convert the shooting script above into a production checklist with locations, performer actions, props, camera positions, audio needs, and estimated timing.
1.materialHint: Topic, platform, duration, people, product details, and shooting conditions (optional)
1.output: Structured spoken lines, visuals, actions, props, and timing guidance
1.prompt: Write a [platform and duration] shooting script about [topic], including hook, spoken lines, visual cues, and call to action.
1.title: Shooting script

2.description: Define shot size, camera, action, and timing
2.followUpPrompt: Review the storyboard above and add shot continuity, backup shots, on-set risks, and a shooting priority for each shot.
2.materialHint: Script, reference videos, target duration, aspect ratio, and available locations (optional)
2.output: Storyboard with shot number, framing, camera, visuals, lines, timing, and transitions
2.prompt: Turn my script into a storyboard with shot number, framing, visual, dialogue, camera, duration, and transition.
2.title: Storyboard

3.description: Plan editing structure, timing, and emotional progression
3.followUpPrompt: Map the editing plan above onto a timeline, marking footage to keep or cut, music beats, caption density, and transition points.
3.materialHint: Script or footage, platform, target duration, audience, and pacing references (optional)
3.output: Section timing, editing rhythm, footage choices, emotional curve, and transition guidance
3.prompt: Design the editing rhythm for [video topic], mapping structure, footage choices, emotional changes, transitions, and pacing by time segment.
3.title: Editing rhythm

4.description: Generate title directions, cover copy, and visual guidance
4.followUpPrompt: Choose the three strongest title-and-cover combinations above and explain the audience, information hierarchy, visual focus, and A/B test for each.
4.materialHint: Video topic, platform, audience, core message, and cover assets (optional)
4.output: Title options, cover copy, composition, visual priorities, and test ideas
4.prompt: Create title and cover options for [video topic], including multiple titles, cover copy, composition, visual priorities, and testing ideas.
4.title: Title and cover
